method: Production scene.ts, math.ts and render-settings.ts transpiled unchanged into a VM. Actual Three object tree, disposal events, textures, render targets, EffectComposer sizing/order/swaps/disposal and pass constructors/settings. Controlled loaders, RAF, context events, canvas, PMREM and per-pass GPU draw replacement. React lifecycle owner disposal is explicitly simulated, not mounted.
limitations: No real browser, WebGL allocation, shader compilation, audio device, raster output or actual network load was exercised.
The mocked room can attach resources upon readiness; actual Stage attaches its mesh tree synchronously and its images resolve asynchronously.
Resource close/dispose counts are checked per traversal; previously disposed resources can be traversed again by late task finalizers.

results.name: initialize waits for both character and room before PMREM and first render
piano material readiness also gates the initial PMREM and render
paused frames skip expensive scene work while telemetry continues
time, inspector time and camera override each invalidate the paused cache
resize dirties the paused cache once and uses logical dimensions only once
desktop and mobile target budgets, MSAA sample counts and hardware cap
screen-only output avoids alternating two full-size MSAA scene targets
context loss after initialization cancels RAF; restoration replaces PMREM and renders frozen time
loads completing while context is lost wait for restoration before PMREM/render
restoration before loads finish defers PMREM/render and creates one RAF chain
unmount during loads releases assets attached later and never starts rendering
room failure followed by owner disposal still releases a late successful actor
character failure followed by owner disposal still releases late room resources
unmount while piano material is pending releases late piano resources
piano material failure propagates and late character success is still disposed
load failure after unmount settles without starting work or double renderer disposal
PMREM failure during restoration releases its generator, restores visibility and resumes safely
dispose releases shared textures, bitmap, geometry, material, instances, skeleton and shadows once
initial PMREM failure rejects initialization and remains cleanly disposable by the owner
environment capture uses the same section-transition energy as the rendered frame

evidenceFormat: Portable numerical report. Raw vertex locations, triangle-index pairs, bone-weight dumps and private workspace paths are omitted. All failure cases, counts and tolerances are retained.
assetProvenance: Measurements of this repository's fictional CC0 avatar and procedural piano; no personal biometric data.
